This week, the rescue and recovery effort in Venezuela continued following last month's devastating earthquakes, the King and Queen revealed they would not be moving back into Buckingham Palace, and Village People frontman Victor Willis died.

But how much attention did you pay to what else happened in the world over the past seven days?
